title: What a fitted parameter measures: reliability and generalisation
summary: Test-retest reliability as an intraclass correlation and why low variance between people makes robust experimental effects poor measures of individual differences; whether learning-model parameters generalise across tasks done by the same people; what a parameter would need before it is read as a property of a person.

objectives.description: Objectives for this unit will be finalised when it is prepared; the outline below names its scope and sources.

preparation.description: Read Hedge, Powell and Sumner (2018) on the two meanings of 'reliable' and the intraclass correlation.
Read the variance components behind the reliabilities (Fig. 4).
Read Part I of Eckstein et al. (2022): parameter generalisability.
Read the comparison with the generalisability ceiling.
